source_title: Water contamination in 'cleanest city' Indore: Death toll mounts as man says infant son among victims (Deccan Herald/PTI)
quote: a man on Wednesday claimed that his six-month-old son died two days ago on December 29 after developing similar symptoms.
notes: Infant [name withheld]; father's claim. State status report (15 Jan) includes a five-month-old boy among 7 deaths (likely the same child; age differs by source).

quote: अब तक दो महिलाओं और एक बुजुर्ग की मौत हो चुकी है.

source_title: Five dead, over 35 hospitalised after consuming contaminated water in Indore's Bhagirathpura (Akashvani/AIR)
quote: Five people have lost their lives after consuming contaminated drinking water in the Bhagirathpura area in Indore district of Madhya Pradesh.
notes: Akashvani (govt broadcaster), CUMULATIVE as of 31 Dec 2025.

source_title: Indore water contamination: 7 lives claimed so far, over 100 hospitalised (Deccan Herald/PTI)
quote: Seven persons have died so far due to diarrhoea and vomiting after allegedly consuming contaminated water
notes: Mayor Pushyamitra Bhargava, 31 Dec 2025. Same article: health dept 3, DM 4 (doctor-confirmed), residents >=8. CUMULATIVE; conflicting counts.

source_title: Indore water contamination: 10 deaths so far, confirms city mayor, over 270 hospitalised (Deccan Herald/PTI)
quote: Indore Mayor Pushyamitra Bhargava on Friday said he has received information about 10 deaths due to a diarrhoea outbreak
notes: Mayor, Friday 2 Jan 2026; health dept data said 4; residents claimed 14. CUMULATIVE.

source_title: Indore water contamination: 38 new diarrhoea cases detected, 110 in hospital; death toll 7 (Deccan Herald/PTI)
quote: Indore Divisional Commissioner Sudam Khade told PTI over the phone that seven deaths have been reported so far as per the health department.
notes: Official count 5 Jan 2026 (up from 6 the previous day); locals claimed 17.

source_title: Bacterial contamination of drinking water led to Indore tragedy: MP govt to HC (ThePrint/PTI)
quote: the government, in a status report submitted to the Madhya Pradesh High Court on January 15, mentioned the deaths of seven people
notes: Official status report 15 Jan 2026. Same article: MGM death audit links 15 deaths 'in some way'; residents claim 24.

source_title: Indore water contamination: MP HC questions 'death audit', appoints retired judge for judicial probe (ThePrint/ANI)
quote: out of 23 reported deaths, 16 were due to water contamination, while the remaining cases were termed inconclusive.
notes: State death-audit report filed in HC 28 Jan 2026; HC questioned its basis ('verbal autopsy') and noted petitioners/media put toll ~30.

source_title: इंदौर के भागीरथपुरा में एक और मौत, एक माह से अस्पताल में भर्ती, वेंटिलेटर पर थी (ETV Bharat Hindi)
quote: विभिन्न संगठनों का कहना है कि भागीरथपुरा में दूषित पानी से ये 32 वीं मौत है.
notes: Translation: 'organisations say this is the 32nd death' ([name withheld], died Sunday night 1 Feb 2026). Unofficial cumulative count.

source_title: Indore water-linked deaths preventable, pipeline tender delays contributed to tragedy: Judicial panel (DT Next/PTI)
quote: the Health Department was informed by February 12 about 35 deaths in Bhagirathpura, of which 22 were considered possibly related to the contaminated drinking water incident.
notes: Judicial commission final report (submitted 18 Aug 2026) as reported by PTI 1 Oct 2026. Residents/Congress claim 36. ETV Bharat/Logical Indian (Aug-Sep 2026, lawyers, unconfirmed) reported 24 of 36 linked.
